title: GTA6 Album Leak Reveals 34-Song Tracklist Ahead of Launch
description: Just four days before the launch of GTA6 on Xbox Series X/S and PS5, a new leak reveals a 34-song tracklist for GTA 6: The Album featuring major artists.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Soundtrack Leak Reveals 34-Song Tracklist Days Before Launch

We are now just four days away from the highly anticipated release of GTA 6 on Xbox Series X/S and PS5. However, the extreme proximity to the launch date is not stemming the tide of leaks that has been plaguing the game for much of the past year. 

According to recent reports, a new video has emerged online—seemingly originating from a record store that received vinyl records of the soundtrack early—showcasing the full 34-song tracklist for the game, titled GTA 6: The Album.

## A Star-Studded Lineup Exposed

The leaked tracklist reportedly features a massive lineup of prominent artists, including Dua Lipa, Lana Del Rey, and Rina Sawayama, among others. Rockstar Games has historically set a gold standard for in-game radio stations and curated soundtracks, and this newly surfaced 34-song list suggests the tradition of top-tier musical curation will continue in the next installment.

While the video appears to show physical vinyl copies received ahead of schedule by a retailer, it remains unconfirmed by official sources. Early shipments arriving at record stores or warehouses days before a major entertainment launch are a known occurrence in the industry, but players should still approach unverified details with caution.

## The Final Days of a Leak-Plagued Development Cycle

Over the past year, GTA 6 has faced an unprecedented wave of leaks, ranging from early development footage to various narrative and feature rumors. This latest soundtrack revelation is merely the latest chapter in a long-running series of pre-release disclosures. 

Despite the constant stream of leaks, consumer anticipation remains at an all-time high as fans prepare to experience the game firsthand on current-generation consoles in just a matter of days.

## Editor's Take

With only four days left until launch, seeing the 34-song tracklist leak via early vinyl shipments feels like a fittingly chaotic end to GTA 6's turbulent pre-release phase. Featuring heavyweights like Dua Lipa and Lana Del Rey, the soundtrack is shaping up to be legendary. Fortunately, players won't have to wait much longer to experience the music in context.
